resources.string: Download Google calendars and events to Android Calendar. Recurring events, exceptions and popup reminders are included. This is opt-in and download-only: local event changes are never uploaded or overwritten. Turning it off keeps downloaded events.
Calendar access could not be enabled. Check calendar permissions and reconnect your account.

Calendar data could not be applied. Local data was retained; try again.
Calendar permission is missing. Review permissions in Calendar sync.
